selection: Two previously identified candidates and ALL six originally correct pilot pairs; opened-data exploratory diagnostic, not independent validation
multiplicity: Holm across all eight real cases separately per estimator, residual mode, and permutation scheme; synthetic p-values descriptive and unadjusted
decision_rule: No estimator selection, ANM score/threshold change, new causal direction, or accuracy claim. Compare all configurations. Robust candidate means both raw and detrended spread checks retain nominal Holm p<=0.05 under IID and heuristic blocks across all estimators; this is descriptive, not structural proof.
